Every time a new tool appears, people say the same thing:

«This will replace designers.»

They said it about Figma.

They said it about Webflow.

Now they’re saying it about AI.

But history tells a different story.

Tools don’t replace great designers.

They replace outdated workflows.

AI doesn’t remove creativity.

It removes the friction between an idea and its execution.

In a few years, everyone will be using AI.

The real advantage won’t be having access to it.

It will be building better systems around it.

We built our project library to fix exactly this. We completely eliminated the guessing game. You start with a proven 3D scene, complex animations, and a premium layout that already work perfectly.

The prompt simply adapts this flawless base to your specific context.

How it works:

1. Log into the platform.

2. Copy a highly refined prompt—think of it as a strict filter that cuts out 99% of useless AI garbage.

3. Get the working 3D framework or interaction 1:1.

4. Refine the details to fit your project—saving you days of endless, aimless prompt tweaking.
